content: {"summary":"Customers report that pre‑ordered games often arrive late or not at all, despite promised delivery windows, causing frustration. Many note that tracking shows wrong locations or delayed status updates, with some packages even missing after the expected delivery time [tk_1347631][tk_1359069][tk_1359037][tk_1360045][tk_1367574]. Delivery delays are common even near warehouses, leading to disappointment [tk_1363786]."}
